interface.title: K 值预测平台 (K-value prediction platform)
interface.field: Analytical / separation chemistry (partition coefficient K in a hexane:ethyl acetate:methanol:water solvent system, cheminformatics ML)
interface.stage_of_work: Method planning before experiments: predicting K and choosing a solvent ratio, plus checking whether the model can be trusted
interface.what_it_is_for: Predict a compound's partition coefficient K from its SMILES and a four-solvent ratio, calibrate it against a few of your own measured K-values, batch-predict whole spreadsheets with separation factors, and get recommended ratios for a target K.

data.note: The data-overview and model-analysis tabs use the built-in training artifacts (29 samples, 10 compounds, 5 ratios, RandomForestRegressor / descriptor_only). Batch prediction used the uploaded batch_prediction_example.csv. Calibration first used the default rows in the on-screen editor (1:1:1:1→1, 1:2:1:2→2), then the uploaded calibration_points_example.csv (4 points: 1:1:1:1, 1:2:1:2, 4:6:4:6, 2:1:2:1), then one point left in the editor.

tree.general: Predict how a compound will split between two phases of a mixed solvent system and choose conditions that give the split you want
tree.specific: Predict K for a SMILES at a hexane:EtOAc:MeOH:water ratio, calibrate it with your own measured K, batch-predict with alpha, and get recommended ratios

features.name: Few-point per-item calibration with automatic mode selection
features.general: Correct a general model for one item using a handful of your own measurements (the README says 1–5; the on-screen caption says 1–3), typed into an editable grid or uploaded; the tool picks the correction method from how many points there are and whether a query matches one, and shows the error before and after
features.specific: Editable ratio/k grid (delete rows) or calibration CSV upload → 待查询比例 → 执行单分子校准预测 → Base vs 校准后 RMSE(K)/MAE(log10K), slope/intercept/idw_power JSON, 校准点拟合结果 and 查询比例预测 with calibration_mode exact_anchor / affine_fallback / ratio_residual_idw and used_anchor_ratios

list the query ratios
run calibration
compare the before/after error metrics
check calibration_mode and used anchors for each query
download the CSV
serves_tasks: Give your measured points and see the error before and after correction

features.name: Target-value condition recommender with exclusion lists
features.general: Building on the measured points you have already given for calibration, set a target value and how many suggestions you want, list conditions already tested or that failed, and get a ranked list of conditions whose calibrated predicted value is closest to the target; excluded ones are flagged with a reason and pushed to the bottom
features.specific: Part of the 校准优先工作流 on the 单分子校准 tab, using the calibration points in the editor or uploaded file: 推荐目标 K, 推荐条数, 排除比例, 已尝试失败比例 → 生成校准优先预测包 → 工作流概览 metrics with deltas, 工作流推荐比例 table (blended_k, top_analogs, calibration_mode, excluded_reason tested_existing/tested_failed, is_excluded) → 下载校准优先工作流 XLSX
steps: enter or upload calibration points on the 单分子校准 tab
set the target K and number of suggestions

press 生成校准优先预测包
read the ranked recommendations and their exclusion flags
download the workflow XLSX
